Brown Hut in Golden Bay – 156 km from Nelson – at the end of Aorere Valley Rd, or
About 180 m upstream from the hut, cross the bridge over the Brown River, then a grass flat, before winding up a well-defined track and into the bush.
The track follows the riverbank for 400 m to Kohaihai carpark where there is a shelter and phone.

doubts: The track can be started from either end (Brown Hut or Kohaihai); it is recorded Brown Hut to Kohaihai as the sections describe it, with Kohaihai as an access point. No road-end feature exists for Brown Hut / Aorere Valley Rd, so the start ref is the Brown Hut link. Aorere Shelter and Lewis Shelter have no exact entry (L3 is the Aorere Shelter Campsite), so their refs are null. Ōparara Arch is called a side trip but is reached from the road beyond Kohaihai, not from the track. An alternative track bypasses the Kohaihai River mouth when it floods; not recorded.
